chunks: Al-Husayn, from an-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu al-Jarud, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I heard him saying: 'Ali (peace be upon him) used to perform the Witr prayer with nine Surahs.'
ai.seo_question: How many Surahs did Imam Ali recite during the Witr prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd and Muhammad ibn Abi Hamza, highlights the specific Sunnah of Imam Ali (peace be upon him) in performing Witr with nine Surahs, a practice often associated with the 'Qunoot' of the Witr prayer. In Shia jurisprudence, this narration supports the preference for reciting multiple Surahs during the odd-numbered prayer, distinguishing it from the two-Rak'ah Fajr or the three-Rak'ah structure where specific Surahs like Al-Ikhlas are commonly recited. It underscores the importance of following the Imams' detailed liturgical practices as a means of spiritual refinement and adherence to the Prophet's tradition.
